files.role: Public unified metadata ledger: strict envelope/version/digest/known-mapping validation, unsupported-transition signaling, content fingerprints and topological producer/consumer indices. One external-history callback boundary, no row-map-file IO.
ranges: SPDX and metadata-only ledger docs state lineage decoding does not open row-map files, rejects unsupported index versions and leaves original Any preservation to callers. Compilable async example constructs version1 empty inline details and a callback returning NotSupported if external data requested; asserts empty transitions. Example is not executed here.

Imports maps/queue/Future/Cursor/Arc, Bytes/Buf, DeepSizeOf, RowAddress/RowAddrRemap layouts, errors, low-level prost wire helpers, Roaring and UUID. Public Debug Mapping has OrderedCompaction(Arc<RowAddrRemap>) and StablePartition(protobuf reference); the latter preserves map_id/size/base_id without opening labels. Neither type derives Clone here.

Public Debug Transition privately stores32-byte fingerprint, ordered protobuf source/destination Vecs and Mapping. Public fingerprint/sources/destinations/mapping getters borrow existing storage. Fingerprint is in-memory identity of encoded transition, not persisted ledger field; getters cannot replace private vectors or mapping. No validation or IO in getters.

Public Debug FragReuseLedger privately stores ordered transitions, u32->position consumer and producer HashMaps, and unsupported flag. Private content_field requires exact case-sensitive last slash-delimited type URL component lance.table.FragmentReuseIndexDetails; plain name without slash also passes. Copies Any.value into Bytes, then scans all wire fields. Known tags1/2 must be length-delimited and exactly one total, including repeated same tag; missing/multiple content is CorruptFile. Other well-formed fields ignored. This differs from parent entry recognition requiring a slash and case-insensitive suffix.

Public async generic decode validates version before envelope. Inline content proceeds without callback. External content decodes ExternalFile, requires offset+size checked u64 sum convertible to usize before invoking FnOnce, then awaits callback and checks returned byte count exactly equals size. Errors from callback propagate unchanged; malformed range/content become CorruptFile. It does not validate path, require positive size, open row-map files or itself seek; callback owns exact-range/storage policy. After await decode_content validates bytes synchronously. Cancellation can drop an in-flight callback future; no rollback/mutation here. No Send/static bound beyond Future<Result<Bytes>>.

Public decode_inline validates index version/envelope, decodes tag1 into Some ledger, returns Ok(None) for tag2 without decoding or validating the ExternalFile payload/range. A structurally length-delimited but malformed external reference can therefore return None here; full external decode is stricter. No IO or callback.

Private decode_content revalidates version, then scans complete content. Legacy tag1 decodes protobuf Version and lifts each group, in received order, into one OrderedCompaction transition using old/new digests and unchanged bitmap bytes. Legacy dataset_version is ignored; graph ordering later replaces version ordering. Every lifted transition passes decode_transition, so malformed legacy data can fail stricter ledger checks. The original serialized Any is not retained in returned ledger.

Tagged content tag2 is CorruptFile under index_version0 before transition interpretation. Under1 require message payload and scan its raw fields. Exact mapping tags3/4 require length-delimited payload; a second recognized mapping, even duplicate same alternative, errors. Tags1/2 treated as source/destination metadata; every other outer transition tag marks unknown. Scanner consumes/validates wire framing first, and recognized wrong-wire/duplicate mapping errors precede unknown omission.

Any unknown outer transition field causes entire transition omission and has_unsupported_transitions=true, even if known mapping also present or no known mapping exists. Source/destination digest and mapping contents are not semantically decoded for omitted transitions. Without unknown fields, missing mapping errors; otherwise protobuf decode and decode_transition run. Unknown content-envelope tags are skipped without setting unsupported. Nested unknown fields inside generated known messages follow prost decoding; this custom scan only checks outer transition fields.

order_lineage validates/reorders supported transitions, then consumer/producer maps are built from their source/destination IDs and new positions. u64->u32 casts are safe for retained records because digest validation already restricted IDs. Omitted transitions contribute no maps/edges and can leave apparent graph gaps; caller must inspect unsupported flag before assuming history completeness. New Vec/maps own their memory, no shared cache or IO.

Public unsupported getter reports omitted transitions; docs permit carrying original serialized details separately. consumer/producer perform expected-constant HashMap lookup and copy position; None means absent from retained supported graph, not proof absence from omitted history. contains_fragment ORs both maps. transitions borrows topologically ordered slice. None/empty distinction is consumed by TaggedLineage, which discards any unsupported ledger (rust/lance-table/src/system_index/frag_reuse/lineage.rs:36-43).

DeepSizeOf children sums both HashMap estimates, transition Vec capacity times Transition inline size, source/destination Vec capacities times digest size, and mapping children. Ordered Arc delegates shared-context accounting; StablePartition adds map_id String capacity. No separate heap cost for bool/fingerprint/scalar base/size; inline storage counted by enclosing footprint. Standard HashMap estimates and Arc dedup rules apply, not measured total RSS. Arithmetic uses ordinary usize multiplication/addition.

Private exact mapping tags are3 OrderedCompaction and4 StablePartition, not an open tag range. validate_index_version admits only signed0/1; every other value including negatives returns NotSupported with actual value and upgrade advice. corrupt wraps Error::corrupt_file_named with fixed name FRI details. Validation errors are not all InvalidInput and retain this context.

next_field uses prost decode_key. Length-delimited: decode u64 length, reject larger than remaining Bytes, split_to checked-by-bound length into a shared slice; initial Any copy already occurred. Other wire types skip with default DecodeContext then return None payload. Wire/parser errors map to CorruptFile; input cursor may be partly advanced on error but it is local. require_message rejects None with tag-specific must-be-length-delimited. No bespoke recursion/depth limit beyond prost helper behavior and no allocation bound separate from provided input.

validate_digests requires each ID below reserved TOMBSTONE_FRAG, physical_rows<=u32MAX and deleted<=physical. RoaringBitmap rejects repeated ID within this side. Destination digests must have zero creation-time deletions. Sum live rows with checked u64 addition, reporting overflow. Empty list sums0; zero-row source/destination allowed. Source/destination cross-overlap and graph repetition are checked separately by lineage ordering; metadata does not prove actual files/counts.

decode_transition first rejects empty sources, validates sources then destinations and requires equal total surviving source rows and total destination physical rows. Empty destinations valid for zero survivors. Fingerprint is BLAKE3 over generated protobuf encode_to_vec of the received known transition before mapping decode, excluding legacy dataset_version and unknown discarded protobuf fields. It is not necessarily a semantic canonical hash of equivalent Roaring layouts: bitmap payload bytes are retained verbatim.

Ordered mapping deserializes RoaringTreemap from borrowed bitmap bytes and rejects trailing bytes by Cursor position. For each source, full-fragment range_cardinality must equal physical-deleted. Construct ordered u32 fragment layouts and delegate compact_with_layout, which enforces membership/offset/layout constraints; wrap dependency error as CorruptFile text. Store Arc remap. Preserve source scan order/destination order; bitmap sorting does not replace their layout order. No row-map external file read.

StablePartition validates map_id with UUID parse and positive map_size_bytes, then stores original reference unchanged. No UUID canonical-text/v4/nil restriction, base_id resolution, actual length/file checksum/labels or row routing validation occurs here. Missing mapping returns CorruptFile. Success moves ordered digests and mapping into private Transition with previously computed fingerprint.

order_lineage first indexes each destination by u64 ID and physical count, rejecting any repeated producer globally. Tracks every source ID in Roaring and rejects repeated consumer globally. This covers repeated IDs across transitions and local duplicates already checked. One fragment may be produced once and consumed once; cycle detection handles self-reuse. Original source fragments need no producer.

For each source with known producer, require source.physical_rows equal producer creation physical rows; later num_deleted_rows may differ and represent intervening deletions. Add one incoming/outgoing edge per shared fragment, so the same producer/consumer pair can have multiple balanced edges. Ready queue initially includes zero-incoming transitions in input order. Allocate incoming Vec, adjacency Vec<Vec>, output capacity and Option-wrapped transition storage. Work scales with retained transitions/digests/edges, plus mapping decode costs.

FIFO topological walk takes each transition once (otherwise explicit visited-twice corruption), appends it, decrements every outgoing edge count and queues when zero. Any unvisited records at end mean cycle. Independent roots preserve serialized relative order; newly ready nodes append behind already-ready nodes, so this is not a global sort by dataset_version or fragment ID. Local counters use ordinary arithmetic justified by constructed graph, not checked arithmetic.

cfg(test) imports legacy compact/details/group/version types and rstest. digest helper stores supplied u64 fields. partition helper has2-row source/destination, nil UUID text, size100/base7 reference; it never opens a map. history serializes only tagged transitions into InlineContent.

message_field writes length-delimited key, varint payload length and bytes for malformed-wire fixtures. ordered builds/deduplicates a RoaringTreemap, serializes with unwrap and creates mapping; address uses RowAddress encoding. assert_corrupt requires CorruptFile variant and message substring, not merely failure. Helpers are private tests only.

Fingerprint test builds ordered source1 physical3/deleted1 -> destination2 rows2 with survivors offsets0/2. Lifted legacy version7 and tagged transition fingerprints must equal; changing survivor offsets to0/1 must differ. It does not prove equal fingerprints for alternate encodings of same bitmap, collision resistance or stable hash across future schema changes.

Mixed fixture legacy source order2 then1 (three survivors) ->3, followed by tagged stable partition3->4. Legacy dataset_version100 is unrelated to topological identity. Decode version1 from generated content; physical counts adjusted to3 on second transition.

Asserts consumer/producer positions for every retained digest, no lookup/member for u32MAX, two supported transitions, exact ordered remap including deleted offset and unknown source None. Stable reference retains base7/size100. No label file or query execution.

Unknown metadata test appends tag17 length-delimited and tag7 varint to a known mapping: whole transition omitted and unsupported flag set. Unknown mapping test has missing known mapping plus tag17 between supported1->2 and3->4, alongside10->11; omitted2->3 gives no consumer2 while other three transitions retained. This tests partial ledger disclosure, not safe maintenance on it.

Four named invalid-lineage cases reject duplicate producer, duplicate consumer, two-node cycle and self-cycle. Multi-fragment edge test serializes consumer before producer, source1 rows4->2/3, later source order3(with one deletion) then2 ->4 rows3; expects producer first, source order preserved and exact deleted/survivor mappings.

Three ambiguous mapping cases test none, duplicate tag4, conflicting3/4; raw fields avoid generated oneof overwrite masking duplicates. Four malformed-wire cases cover truncated length, wrong transition wire, wrong mapping wire and invalid tag0. Require CorruptFile plus diagnostic substring.

Four digest cases cover tombstone ID, physical_rows u32MAX+1, deleted>physical and unequal row conservation. Inconsistent-lineage test preserves each transition live-row conservation but changes consumed fragment2 physical count3 versus producer2, requiring distinct physical_rows error.

Bad bitmap/reference test rejects source offset outside physical rows, wrong-fragment bitmap via survivor count, and ../escape UUID text. All-deleted source physical2/deleted2 with no destinations and empty bitmap is valid; remap returns Some(None) for its first address. Nil UUID remains accepted by other fixtures.

Version test admits empty v0, rejects v2 NotSupported with value, and rejects tagged transition in v0 as CorruptFile requiring version1. Parameterized async legacy equivalence has inline/external cases; helper converts ordered mapping through legacy Group into FragReuseGroup. This is current-source legacy serializer comparison, not a released historical fixture.

Legacy equivalence fixture has versions10/11: source2 then1 ->3, independent10->11, then3(with deletion)->4. Uses legacy serializer and CompactFragReuseIndex as comparison oracle. External descriptor path details.binpb offset7 size of serialized content; no actual object store.

Build inline or external raw envelope and exact Any URL, decode with index_version1. Callback asserts external mode and full descriptor equality and returns owned content; inline must never invoke it. Expect three transitions; for six source/unknown addresses manually follow consumer/remap chain and compare old compact index output including deletions. It tests generated-current legacy representation, not released writer fixtures or disk reads.

Independent transition test preserves source order10 then1. Five raw invalid-envelope cases reject missing, duplicate same content, conflicting inline/external, truncated length and u64MAX length. External callback would panic if invoked, confirming these errors precede IO in test intent.

Async version2/default Any case requires NotSupported/Please upgrade without callback. Two external cases reject offsetMAX+size1 overflow before IO and short read expected2/received1 after callback; callback asserts overflow did not reach it. No explicit wrong type URL, zero-size external, decode_inline malformed external body or callback-error test local here.

Two proptest functions feed arbitrary byte vectors length0..4096 (exclusive upper bound) to private content parser and public async envelope parser via block_on. Ignore Result to assert no panic; envelope callback returns NotSupported and does no external IO. These fuzz-style source tests are not exhaustive proofs and were not run. File has20 test functions:35 ordinary instantiated cases plus two property tests; external-read behavior uses callbacks only.
files.limits: Every1042 physical lines read in four bounded outputs. Full row-map reading, query fallback, attempt assembly/conservation against live data and commit publication remain pending. Legacy lifting is existing read behavior, not new migration design. Property/unit tests and derived edge cases are source evidence, not executed qualification.

files.role: Fragment-reuse public module routing, reserved identifiers, existing legacy metadata conversions and materialized/compact remap adapters. These frozen compatibility surfaces are documented without modification or feature extension.
ranges: SPDX, public gate/ledger/lineage/metadata modules and imports connect Arrow, shared ownership, metadata, legacy serde, Roaring and core remaps. Public reserved name is __lance_frag_reuse and details filename details.binpb. This file combines existing compatibility models/adapters with module routing; new tagged logic is in child modules. No async production operation, IO or unsafe block here.

Public is_frag_reuse_index_entry requires exact reserved name plus Some details with a slash-containing URL and case-insensitive final type name equal protobuf full_name. It does not inspect index_version/details bytes/flags. Public FragDigest derives Debug/Clone/Eq/serde/DeepSizeOf and exposes id:u64 and physical/deleted counts:usize without constructor validation.

Borrowed FragDigest->protobuf copies ID and casts counts to u64. Fragment->FragDigest requires physical_rows via expect, defaults missing deletion file or unknown deleted count to0; it does not read deletion metadata. Protobuf->FragDigest is TryFrom<Result> but always Ok with unchecked u64->usize casts, potentially truncating on narrow targets. No deleted<=physical or tombstone-ID guard.

Public FragReuseGroup stores raw changed-row-address bytes and ordered old/new digest vectors, with serde/equality/deep-size derives. Encoder clones bytes/converts vectors; decoder moves bytes and collects fallible digest conversions, which locally always succeed. No bitmap decode, trailing check, row conservation or sorting. Empty groups allowed by data representation.

Public FragReuseVersion stores dataset_version and group Vec with standard derives. Bidirectional protobuf conversions preserve current sequence order and version; decoder delegates group conversion, no sort or monotonic-version validation.

old_frag_ids/new_frag_ids allocate Vecs flattening groups and preserving order/duplicates. new_frag_bitmap first allocates full new-ID Vec then casts every ID to u32 into Roaring, deduplicating/truncating without validation. These methods expose metadata only.

Public content enum has Inline(FragReuseIndexDetails) and External(ExternalFile), with serde/deep-size/equality. Public details contains only legacy versions. Borrowed details->InlineContent converts then stable-sorts ascending dataset_version, emits legacy_versions and empty transitions. Reverse reads only legacy_versions, silently discards all tagged transitions, and does not sort. This is an existing legacy representation, not a valid tagged-history roundtrip or a recommendation to extend its writer.

Details.new_frag_bitmap unions all new IDs across all versions, including intermediate retired IDs, using unchecked u32 casts and per-version Vec allocation. Public legacy FragReuseIndex is retained for API/serde compatibility and owns public UUID, materialized map Vec and details. Comment says dataset loading uses compact adapter; full current reader dispatch remains separate pending evidence. DeepSizeOf counts maps/details children; UUID owns no heap.

Legacy new stores supplied UUID/maps/details without relating or validating them. is_empty tests all maps empty, ignoring details. remap_row_id starts Some input then sequentially queries each map; absent key passes through, mapped None stays deleted and later maps skipped. Values named row IDs here follow physical-address remap use, not stable logical IDs. No chain cycle search: applies each version map once.

Legacy in-place loop applies each map to each Some element; None remains, absent passes through. RowAddrTreeMap adapter unwraps row_addrs(), so any full-fragment selection panics; maps/deleted filters materialize a new set. RoaringTreemap adapter similarly filter-maps all addresses into a new deduplicated set. Full-fragment iterator condition is rust/lance-select/src/mask.rs:493-514. Order/duplicate multiplicity are set semantics.

Legacy RecordBatch/Array adapters pass closures into shared remap helpers; fragment bitmap delegates metadata helper. Public Result on batch/bitmap does not prevent helper assertion/downcast/iterator panics. These wrappers do not perform IO, schema lookup or synchronization.

Public CompactFragReuseIndex derives Debug/Clone/Eq, exposes UUID/details but keeps RowAddrRemap private. Docs motivate bitmap/rank compact representation rather than per-row HashMaps. DeepSizeOf sums remap/details children; retained raw bitmap bytes in details and decoded remap both consume storage. Public details can be mutated independently of private remap after construction, so representation consistency is caller-owned.

Public doc(hidden) from_row_id_maps builds RowAddrRemap::direct per supplied HashMap then chains them, storing supplied details unchanged. It preserves a materialized compatibility/testing path; no relation/validation between maps and details and no IO.

Public try_new traverses details.versions in existing Vec order (does not sort by dataset_version), then groups. Deserialize each RoaringTreemap and wrap errors as Index with vector version/group positions; no Cursor exhaustion/trailing-byte check. Convert old/new digest ID/physical counts through fragment_layout. Deleted counts are ignored by this constructor, unlike ledger digest validation.

Collect per-version GroupInputWithLayout, call compact_with_layout, wrap any layout error as Index with version position and original text, append remap then chain all versions. Success retains original details and UUID. Empty versions/groups pass according to core constructor; no global graph uniqueness/topological sort. This differs from ledger reconstruction and must not be used as new tagged format foundation.

row_addr_remap borrows private chain; is_empty delegates; remap_row_id converts outer None (unaffected or out-of-range offset) to Some original and preserves deletion inner None. In-place delegates core remap. Tree-map adapter unwraps enumerable partial-only selection, then remaps/filter-deletes; Roaring adapter also materializes new set. All synchronous; missing-map behavior is deliberately pass-through.

Compact batch docs explicitly assume exactly two columns and name btree/value-row_id or vector/row_id-vector examples; wrappers invoke shared functions. Array wrapper returns UInt64 PrimitiveArray; bitmap wrapper delegates legacy metadata rule. Neither validates input on its own, and no entire-index loader/writer is implemented here.

Shared RecordBatch helper asserts exactly2 schema fields, computes other index1-row_id_idx without checked subtraction, accesses selected column and assumes UInt64 through AsArray. Reads values buffer ignoring input validity and creates Some for every underlying value, so a null row-ID slot is treated as its backing numeric value. Remap closure mutates owned Option vector; collect surviving original positions and new IDs into two Vecs. Deleted mappings drop rows, retaining input order. Caller must ensure row_id_idx0/1 and appropriate nonnull semantics.

Create UInt64 selection array and Arrow take other column, propagating error. Build nonnullable UInt64 mapped ID array, pair with taken values, sort two columns by original positions and RecordBatch::try_new using original schema. Allocates batch-sized buffers; does not stream. Original input null row-ID validity is not restored, unlike array helper. Metadata/schema retained through existing Arc.

Shared array helper downcasts to UInt64 with expect, enumerates preserving each input null as None and values as Some, invokes closure then builds PrimitiveArray from option Vec. Deleted mappings become null slots rather than dropping rows; length/order remain. Wrong physical type panics, no Result. This differs from batch helper both in input-null handling and deletion shape.

Shared bitmap helper walks versions/groups in stored order and removes each old ID with unchecked as u32, counting successful removals. If some but not all old vector entries removed, source comments link historical straddle bug and explain withholding new IDs to avoid claiming unindexed rows; scan/persist behavior is rationale awaiting complete consumers. Empty/zero-overlap group makes no insertion; duplicates in old list can make a logically full set look partial.

Straddling group emits tracing warning and continues after removals, deliberately omitting destinations. Complete covered group inserts all new IDs as u32; later groups see progressively updated bitmap. Returns Ok unconditionally in current code, unlike newer recalculation helper that errors on partial groups. No physical index rebuild or persistence; preserve existing legacy behavior.

fragment_layout checked-converts ID and physical_rows to u32 or Index error naming vector version/group, old/new role and invalid value. Does not itself reject reserved u32MAX ID or compare deleted counts; core remap applies its separate layout checks. Returns pair unchanged on success.

cfg(test) imports rstest; addr fixture encodes RowAddress; serialize_changed deduplicates/sorts Roaring, preallocates serialized size and unwraps write; digest fixture always sets deleted count0. Therefore subsequent deletion examples demonstrate old constructor ignores digest deletion count and uses bitmap/layout.

Compact chain test builds version1 source1 physical4 with survivors0/2/3 split10(rows1)/11(rows2), plus source3 entirely removed; version2 survivors10:0 and11:1 merge20(rows2). Details roundtrip through legacy serializer before construction, exercising its version sort; raw digest deletion counts remain0.

Asserts source1:0/3 survive to20:0/1, source1:1/2 and3:0 deleted; unknown2:0 and out-of-range1:4 pass through. In-place vector confirms deletion and preexisting None behavior and order. No record-batch/null/full-fragment adapter exercised.
Malformed bitmap bytes1/2/3 must yield Error::Index with exact version0/group0 prefix. Only bad serialization is tested here, not trailing bytes after otherwise valid payload.

Three named layout cases reject unknown bitmap source fragment2, source1 offset1 when physical1, and duplicate old fragment1. Require Error::Index plus FRI version0, rewrite group0 and specific reason text. No global producer/consumer cycle validation expected for this adapter.

Async-tagged serialization test contains no await/IO. Constructs reverse dataset versions2 then1, each one group with arbitrary invalid bitmap bytes and nonconserving source1-row to two1-row destinations. It tests permissive metadata conversion, not usable remap validity.

Convert to InlineContent and back; assert two versions sorted1 then2 and exact bitmap bytes/old/new digests in each. Sorting occurs in encoder; reverse converter preserves supplied order. This file has four test functions, six instantiated cases, with no local tests for materialized-map wrappers, array/batch null differences, straddle healing or full-fragment panics. No tests executed.
files.limits: Every856 physical lines read in four bounded outputs. Full index loader/query/commit consumers remain pending; local remap/codec behavior does not prove complete legacy or tagged release compatibility. Source read-only, no network/build/test/benchmark. Existing fallback paths are documented, not recommendations for new features.
